title: Just launched my Quant Finance Coaching & Fiverr Services
author: SameRelation941
selftext:
After gaining experience as a **Quantitative Analyst at HSBC** and a **Junior Quantitative Analyst at Société Générale**, I’ve decided to start my own coaching program and offer freelance services on Fiverr.  
I’ve turned the knowledge and practical experience I gained into a structured course covering quantitative finance, financial modeling, market analysis, statistics, and institutional approaches to the financial markets.  
I’m excited to begin this new chapter and would appreciate any advice from others who have transitioned from corporate finance to freelancing or coaching. Thanks!
